title: Compass and Current
author: Marguerite Nakamura
blurb: Vesper Iversen, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
